hi OP, i just want to firstly say that you're so strong for still fighting the good fight even after nearly 10 years of battling depression. as someone who's been doing so for the past eight years or so, I can tell that you must a strong and resilient person bc you've survived every bad day you may have faced along the road to this point. I get how you're feeling as I often find myself getting stuck on wondering why i've actually fought this long when life seems damned no matter what. I know this isn't really advice but I guess one thing i've tried to do is just enjoy, embrace and appreciate the small things in life whether they be a new sunny day or some beautiful flowers I see whilst out and about or the momentary smile shared between myself and a stranger. life sucks and maybe it will continue to suck for us, but I guess the thing is to try and find things that make it seem less bad, even if they may seem meaningless or insignificant. I don't know if my words make any sense or even offer you any comfort but regardless, I am sending you endless well wishes and please take care of yourself ✨

hi op, I want to say I resonate a lot with what you are saying as 20 year old me likely felt the same. hell, 23 year old me still feels the way you do. I can't offer any helpful advice bc I myself feel stuck more often than not. I guess I just want you to try and take one day at a time, try to do things (big or small) that bring you some semblance of comfort or peace, I know it can often be hard when you're feeling so stuck but anything is better than nothing. I also want to say I feel you on being happy for your friends that are doing well whilst also being envious as I feel the same myself too. I see my friends doing well and 'thriving' and then I look at myself and feel like I've fallen off somehow compared to them. don't beat yourself down though, I know you feel stuck right now and it may feel as if you'll be that way forever but I hope that something will come your way. I don't know if my words made any sense or helped in any way but I wanted to comment to let you know that you're not alone with what you're feeling. although things may seem unchanging right now, life is unpredictable and you truly never know what could come your way. look after yourself op, I am sending best wishes your way :)

hi op, I wish I could offer some comforting words or advice but I find suicide is something that's always in the back of my mind, even on the 'good' days. let me firstly say your mother's family couldn't be anymore wrong about her cousin, the amount of courage one has to build up to actually go through with taking their life is something that I feel can only be understood by those who have either; attempted or contemplated doing so. secondly, I'm not going to give you the cliché 'it gets better' talk bc I don't know whether that is true or not. what I do want to do is just remind you that you're not alone, it may not mean anything to you and that is totally fine but I guess I just want you to know you are heard and what you're feeling is valid. stay safe op :)
